p, K = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

def fast_pow(base, power):
    ans = 1
    while power:
        if power & 1:
            ans = (ans * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        power >>= 1
    return ans

if K == 0:
    print(fast_pow(p, p - 1))
elif K == 1:
    print(fast_pow(p, p))
else:
    vis = [False] * p
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(p):
        if vis[i]:
            continue
        size = 0
        tmp = i
        while not vis[tmp]:
            size += 1
            vis[tmp] = True
            tmp = (tmp * K) % p
        if size > 1:
            cnt += 1
    print(fast_pow(p, cnt))
